#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Ztest testing framework
 * @defgroup ztest_test Ztest testing framework
 * @ingroup ztest
 * @{
 */

extern const struct ztest_arch_api ztest_api;

struct ztest_unit_test {
	const char *name;
	ztest_test_t test;
	ztest_setup_t setup;
	ztest_teardown_t teardown;
#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
	struct ztest_unit_test_stats *stats;
#endif
};

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
struct ztest_unit_test_stats {
	struct ztest_unit_test *test;
	uint32_t run_count;
	uint32_t skip_count;
	uint32_t fail_count;
	uint64_t duration_ns;
};
#endif

#if defined(CONFIG_ZTEST_SHUFFLE)
#define ZTEST_DMEM
#else
#define ZTEST_DMEM __ztest_test_data
#endif

#ifndef __ztest_test_suite_name
#define __ztest_test_suite_name
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
/* Forward declaration */
struct ztest_unit_test_stats;

#define Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(suite, test) z_ztest_unit_test_stats__##suite##__##test
#define Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(suite, test) z_ztest_unit_test__##suite##__##test
#else
#define Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(suite, test) z_ztest_unit_test__##suite##__##test
#define Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(suite, test) z_ztest_unit_test__##suite##__##test
#endif

#define z_ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown)                                      \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(                               \
		__ztest_test_suite_name, fn) = {                                                      \
		.name = #fn, .test = fn, .setup = setup, .teardown = teardown,                       \
		IF_ENABLED(CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS, (.stats = NULL,))                                \
	};                                                                                       \
	STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_unit_test, Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(                         \
							__ztest_test_suite_name, fn))

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
#define ztest_unit_test_with_stats(fn)                                                             \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(                              \
		__ztest_test_suite_name, fn) = {.name = #fn, .test = fn, .stats = NULL};            \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test_stats Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(                  \
		__ztest_test_suite_name, fn) = {                                                   \
		.test = &Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn),                       \
	};                                                                                         \
	static void z_ztest_register_test_stats_##__ztest_test_suite_name##__##fn(void)             \
	{                                                                                          \
		Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn).stats =                        \
			&Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn);                \
	}                                                                                          \
	Z_TEST_REGISTER_TEST_STATS(z_ztest_register_test_stats_##__ztest_test_suite_name##__##fn)

#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown_with_stats(fn, setup, teardown)                             \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(                              \
		__ztest_test_suite_name, fn) = {                                                   \
		.name = #fn, .test = fn, .setup = setup, .teardown = teardown, .stats = NULL};     \
	static ZTEST_DMEM struct ztest_unit_test_stats Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(                  \
		__ztest_test_suite_name, fn) = {                                                   \
		.test = &Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn),                       \
	};                                                                                         \
	static void z_ztest_register_test_stats_##__ztest_test_suite_name##__##fn(void)             \
	{                                                                                          \
		Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn).stats =                        \
			&Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_STATS_NAME(__ztest_test_suite_name, fn);                \
	}                                                                                          \
	Z_TEST_REGISTER_TEST_STATS(z_ztest_register_test_stats_##__ztest_test_suite_name##__##fn)
#endif

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * @details This macro defines a test case, which can be later added to a test
 * suite. This should not be used directly. Use @ref ztest_unit_test or
 * @ref ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown instead.
 */
#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
#define ztest_unit_test(fn) ztest_unit_test_with_stats(fn)
#else
#define ztest_unit_test(fn)                                                                        \
	z_ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, ztest_empty_setup, ztest_empty_teardown)
#endif

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @details This macro defines a test case with setup and teardown functions,
 * which can be later added to a test suite. The setup function will be called
 * before the test case is executed, and the teardown function will be called
 * after the test case is executed. This should not be used directly. Use
 * @ref ztest_unit_test or @ref ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown instead.
 */
#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_TEST_STATS
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown)                                        \
	ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown_with_stats(fn, setup, teardown)
#else
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown)                                        \
	z_ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown)
#endif

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @details This macro defines a test suite, which is a collection of test
 * cases. The test suite will be executed by the test runner. Test cases must
 * be defined within the call to this macro.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param ... A list of test cases, separated by commas.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...)                                                               \
	static const char *Z_TEST_SUITE_NAME = #suite;                                           \
	static const char __ztest_test_suite_name[] = #suite;                                    \
	void z_ztest_run_test_suite_##suite(const void *p)                                       \
	{                                                                                        \
		ztest_run_tests((const struct ztest_unit_test *)__ztest_unit_test_start,              \
				(const struct ztest_unit_test *)__ztest_unit_test_end, #suite);           \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a predicate.
 *
 * @details This macro defines a test suite that will only be executed if the
 * predicate is true. This is useful for tests that depend on a certain
 * configuration or hardware. The test suite will be executed by the test
 * runner. Test cases must be defined within the call to this macro.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param predicate A boolean expression that determines if the test suite
 * should be executed.
 * @param ... A list of test cases, separated by commas.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_predicate(suite, predicate, ...)                                          \
	static const char *Z_TEST_SUITE_NAME = #suite;                                           \
	static const char __ztest_test_suite_name[] = #suite;                                    \
	void z_ztest_run_test_suite_##suite(const void *p)                                       \
	{                                                                                        \
		if (predicate) {                                                                       \
			ztest_run_tests((const struct ztest_unit_test *)__ztest_unit_test_start,          \
					(const struct ztest_unit_test *)__ztest_unit_test_end, #suite);       \
		} else {                                                                               \
			ztest_test_skip();                                                                 \
		}                                                                                      \
	}

/**
 * @brief Run a test suite.
 *
 * @details This macro runs a test suite. This is usually called from the main
 * function of the test application.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 */
#define ztest_run_test_suite(suite)                                                                \
	z_ztest_run_test_suite_##suite(NULL)

/**
 * @} ztest_test
 */

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
